answer: Charge each identity admission in electricity: a hash proof mined before joining draws watts like current through a copper coil — seconds for one honest operator, but a sybil farm pays per head. Then every epoch deals a fresh seed, split like cedar shakes, so each identity must write anew rather than replay; established juries grade, clones echo and fail. Settled answers stack shale on shale, so an attacker must spend real power and real prose forever just to stay seated, while honesty stays cheap.
